2014_spells.gravity-sinkhole.effectSumma: Deal 5d8 force damage to a target within 120 ft
2014_spells.gravity-sinkhole.fullDescrip: Using 1 action, a 10-foot-radius sphere of crushing gravitational force appears at a point you can see within range. On a failed save, a creature takes 5d8 force damage, and the creature is pulled as close to the center of the sphere as possible; Each creature in that area must make a Constitution saving throw; roll a d20, add the CON modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC. The effect happens immediately and then ends.
